name: Michael Myers
imageAlt: Michael Myers standing at the top of a staircase in official Halloween: The Game artwork
summary: The Boogeyman: the solo hunter in the 1v4 multiplayer match.

sections.title: How Michael Plays
sections.body: One player takes the role of Michael Myers, stalking four Civilian players and the town's NPC residents. Use Killer Sense and Stalk to find targets, Shape Jump to cross darkness unseen, and three selected loadout abilities to control encounters.

sections.title: Beginner Priorities
sections.body: Hunt residents and Special Targets instead of committing to long chases against one player. Create darkness, stalk before using Shape Jump, and save long-cooldown loadout abilities for high-impact situations.

name: Civilians
imageAlt: Five playable Civilians in the official Heroes of Haddonfield character lineup
summary: Four-player side of Halloween: The Game: warn and escort residents, call police, prepare randomized escapes, use Perk Decks, and survive Michael Myers.

sections.title: How Civilians Play
sections.body: Four players locate and warn NPC residents, search for tools and escape items, call police, and move residents toward randomized exits while Michael hunts the town. Each Civilian combines different stats, a signature trait, and a customizable Perk Deck.

sections.title: Beginner Priorities
sections.body: Split tasks without becoming isolated: one player can warn residents while another searches phones or escape objectives. Avoid unnecessary noise, carry a defensive item when possible, and stay after death for spectator support and a possible reinforcement return.
